verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's documented guarded rollouts progressively raise traffic to a new variation while monitoring selected metrics for regressions, which covers the metric-guarded rollout and regression detection. Automatic rollback is only implied by a marketing line about Autopilot rolling back broken releases; the guarded-rollout excerpt itself does not document an automatic rollback on regression. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that guarded rollouts automatically roll back on a detected regression, details on metric thresholds and rollback configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically

citations.quote: A guarded rollout progressively increases traffic to the new variation while monitoring selected metrics for regressions until the rollout reaches 100%.
